item.title: Martha Stewart Celebrates Her Campaign With Mother at Indochine
item.description: "Mother Martha" was toasted at Indochine for her new campaign with the denim brand.

item.title: Michael Kors Taps Corey Moran as Chief Marketing Officer
item.description: He previously spent 10 years at Google, most recently as head of industry for its fashion and luxury segments.

item.title: Who Was Saks Global Paying Before the Bankruptcy?
item.description: The luxury retailer paid out $1.4 billion to creditors in the three months before succumbing to Chapter 11 in January.

item.title: Lainey Wilson’s Golden West Pays Homage to Home State Louisiana With New Cowboy Boot
item.description: The magnolia is the state flower of Louisiana.

item.title: Vince Parties With Bloomingdale’s in L.A.
item.description: The Sheats-Goldstein residence was a particularly appropriate setting given Bloomingdale's current "California Love" campaign and Vince's California roots.

item.title: Bark Jacobs: You Can Now Customize Marc Jacobs Bags With Your Pet’s Face
item.description: Thanks to Marc Jacobs' latest offering, the cat's not out of the bag: It's on it.

item.title: KidSuper Heads to the Moon for Spring Campaign
item.description: Colm Dillane created the "The Boy Who Jumped the Moon" storybook-come-to-life with creatives in Amsterdam.

item.title: Iota Is Plotting Retail Expansion With Ulta, Nordstrom
item.description: The prestige body care brand is entering 860 Ulta Beauty doors March 30, and expanding its existing digital partnership with Nordstrom into stores.

item.title: Carolina Herrera, Pat Petznick Wick to Be Awarded Fresh Start Women’s Foundation’s Inaugural Icon Award at 30th Annual Gala
item.description: Wes Gordon, creative director of Carolina Herrera, will accept the award on Herrera's behalf.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Yoox CEO Mirko Nobili Unveils Vision for Brand’s Rebirth
item.description: The executive discussed plans to structurally evolve the platform with a focus on fashion, art, design, culture and individuality, alongside operational improvements, a refreshed visual identity, and enhanced customer experiences.
